# core/identity

**ADR:** `docs/adr/ADR-PROD-001-join-access-and-verify.md` — open signup + waitlist; Join is email → OTP → password; Verify carries `purpose`. Snapshot `join(email, password)` is superseded. Password rotation: `docs/adr/ADR-IMPL-020-change-password.md`.
**Owns:** schema `auth.*` — user, session, account, verification, jwks, rate_limit (generated by Better Auth CLI, moved to pgSchema("auth")); app-owned `auth.otp_cooldown` (sha256 key + HMAC otp_hash, never the address).
**Publishes:** `member.registered` (post-commit hook; reconciled every 15 minutes by members' `reconcile-profiles`), `member.deleted` (Better Auth's `beforeDelete`), `member.password_changed` (`POST /v1/account/password`, `reason: "change"`). `member.email_verified` is in the catalogue (`noConsumer`) but nothing publishes it yet.
**Routes:** `GET /v1/account/password` (`profile:read-self`, `read`: `{ hasPassword }`, which the app asks after a join code) · `POST /v1/account/password` (`profile:update-self`; below) · Better Auth at `/api/auth/*` through the facade's `handler`.
**Consumes:** none.
**Ports:** `EmailSender` (satisfied by integration/email), `EventPublisher` (platform).
**Facade (`src/api/index.ts`):** `handler` (Better Auth at /api/auth/*; code sends run under a per-address lock and reset/verification-code answers wait for a floor), `getSession(headers, { fresh? })`, `requireMember`, `requireRole`, `deleteAccount(headers, password)`, `listUsersCreatedBefore(before)` (members' reconcile), `registeredEmail(memberId)` (the email member.registered carries, read from `auth.user`; null once the account is deleted — members makes a profile row on demand only for an account it answers), `auth` (for tests only).

**Jobs:** `retention-auth` (daily, ADR-IMPL-077): expired sessions after 7 days, expired verifications after a day, Better Auth's rate-limit rows idle for 2 hours, OTP cooldowns after a day — in batches. Indexes Better Auth's lookups need (0048): `rate_limit (key)`, `verification (identifier)`, `user (created_at)`, in SQL only (`schema/auth.ts` is Better Auth's generated file).
**Out of scope:** 2FA, social login, admin dashboard, avatars, passkeys (v2). So `/api/auth/expo-authorization-proxy` (mounted by `expo()`, an open redirect to any https URL) is not served (`disabledPaths`, `library-assumptions.test.ts`); if social login ships, allow-list the providers' authorization hosts instead.
**Invariants tested:** recipient = user.email & awaited · no dead session guard + route inventory · register→verify→exactly one event + lockout at 5 OTP attempts · delete = zero rows + journal tombstone · delete needs the password: an empty, blank or missing one is `400 INVALID_PASSWORD` (club-guards `hooks.before` on `/delete-user`, for HTTP and in-process calls alike; Better Auth 1.6.31 checks it only when non-empty, then only the session's age) — a member who joined by code and never set a password sets one first (Forgot password?) · HIBP refusal, on the first password after a code Join too: `auth.api.setPassword` has no path, so Better Auth's plugin never sees it and `POST /v1/account/password` checks first (`breach.ts`, k-anonymity range query; 400 VALIDATION on `newPassword`, or 503 SERVICE_DISABLED when the list cannot be read — it fails closed; `password.test.ts`) · per-route rate limits (429 + Retry-After) · `POST /v1/account/password` limited per member as `profile.write` in a bucket of its own (`pw:m:<id>`), after `authorize` (ADR-IMPL-047), and the only route where a signed-in member changes it; its refusals follow Better Auth's error code, never whether the member has a password: INVALID_PASSWORD → "That password isn't right." on `currentPassword`, PASSWORD_COMPROMISED → the breach message on `newPassword`, and a change while the plugin cannot read the list (its code-less 500 "Failed to check password") → 503 SERVICE_DISABLED as for a first password (`password.test.ts`); a change ends every other session and keeps the one that made it: Better Auth's `/api/auth/change-password` and `/api/auth/verify-password` are not served (`disabledPaths`) · `/api/auth/sign-up/email` is not served either (`disabledPaths`; Join is OTP-first, path A): no role-null-vs-member account oracle, no unsolicited codes (`register-path.test.ts`); in-process `auth.api.signUpEmail` (seeds, tests, load bench) still works · `getSession` reads once past the cookie cache when the cached user is unverified, so the owner of an address registered unverified earlier lands signed in after their code · a sign-in code that could not be mailed is answered **503 `EMAIL_UNDELIVERABLE`** with `reason` (`inactive_recipient` · `timeout` · `provider_error`): the send callback records its outcome for the request (Better Auth's request state) because 1.6.31's `runInBackgroundOrAwait` swallows the error, and club-guards' `hooks.after` reads it (keep `advanced.backgroundTasks` unset, or the send leaves the request); a reset or verification code keeps its constant 200 (anti-enumeration); a resend inside the cooldown stays a silent 200 (`otp-colleagues.test.ts`) · two code requests for one address at the same moment mail one code: the facade's `handler` runs each code send (`send-verification-otp`, `request-password-reset`, `forget-password/email-otp`) under a transaction-scoped advisory lock on `otp:<type>:<address>` (`otp-send-lock.ts`; at most 3 held per process, so the pool keeps connections, and requests for one address queue in memory before taking one, so a burst for one address cannot hold them all), and the second finds the first one's code (`otp-colleagues.test.ts`) · a reset or verification code's answer (any of the three send routes) is held until Postmark's timeout (`POSTMARK_TIMEOUT_MS`, 4 s) has passed since the request came in, so an address with an account and one without answer alike; counted before the send lock, waited out after it; sign-in codes and 429s are not held — only a body the club reads as Better Auth does (a JSON content type, better-call's rule) counts as a sign-in: any other body to those routes is held too, so a form-shaped request cannot pass a reset code as a sign-in nor skip the lock's reading (`tests/otp-timing.test.ts`, `tests/otp-send-lock.test.ts`) · every failed code mail is logged once as `otp send failed` with purpose, reason, status and Postmark ErrorCode (never the address, the code or the provider's message), counted as `otp_send_failed{purpose,reason}` beside `otp_sent{purpose}`, and the first of each 5 minutes per process posts to `OPS_WEBHOOK` (`tests/otp-observability.test.ts`; RUNBOOK "Postmark down / OTP not arriving") · a reset by email code signs out every session (`revokeSessionsOnPasswordReset`) · a reset by code is checked before its code is used (club-guards `hooks.before` on `/email-otp/reset-password`): letters only → 400 `PASSWORD_TOO_WEAK` "Use at least one number or symbol.", breached → 400 `PASSWORD_COMPROMISED`, list unreachable → 503 `PASSWORD_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE`; the same code then takes a good password (`tests/hibp.test.ts`); the HIBP plugin stays as the backstop. The rule's regex lives in `club-guards.ts` until the shared `PASSWORD_RULE` lands. · writes read the session fresh: the host's principal (and `requireMember`) passes `{ fresh: true }` on every method but GET/HEAD/OPTIONS, so `getSession` skips the cookie cache (`disableCookieCache`) and a member deleted, or a session ended, on another device is 401 at once instead of for `SESSION_COOKIE_CACHE_SECONDS` (`delete.test.ts`). Reads keep the cache. · the session is kept by the server (ADR-IMPL-076): each process keeps a verified member's session per token (a hash of the signed token in the one cookie Better Auth reads the session from, `authCookies.sessionToken`, never another cookie of the same name; kept only when Better Auth verified that very token; a request with a bearer token, which `bearer()` reads instead, is neither answered from the cache nor kept and reads fresh, and a write with one forgets the member a fresh read finds behind it) for `SESSION_COOKIE_CACHE_SECONDS`, never past the session's expiry, at most 10 000; a miss reads fresh, a write reads fresh and puts its answer back, and a write to `/api/auth/*`, a password change and a deletion forget the member's entries on that process; a read that began before its token or its member was forgotten puts nothing back, noted per token and per member, never one counter for all (`session-cache.test.ts`, `session-race.test.ts`, `apps/api/test/session-l1.test.ts`). Residual: a write that passed this check just before the deletion committed can still land after `member.deleted` was handled. · Better Auth's own log lines go through the club's logger and `errorForLog` (`logger.log`, no `level`, so its default `warn` holds: warnings and errors only; `betterAuthLine` writes `better-auth: <first line>`, or `better-auth: failed query` when the message reads as a query or holds an address; a code mail that failed reaches it as `Failed to run background task:` with `OtpSendFailed`, whose message is the reason and status only), and an error that is not one of its answers (a failed query) leaves `auth.handler` (`onAPIError.throw`) for the host's error contract: 500 INTERNAL, logged `unhandled` through `errorForLog`. Its answers (400, 401, 429…) are unchanged. Two lines of `@better-auth/core` that wrote to the console themselves are removed by `patches/@better-auth%2Fcore@1.6.31.patch` (`patchedDependencies`; the API image copies `patches/`): a failed join's `console.error(error)` and the session-data cookie's JSON error, which quotes the cookie. A Better Auth upgrade must carry the patch forward: `bun install` fails while it no longer applies. A code request that fails still waits out the answer floor, and a signing-key read that fails is logged by the host's principal (`jwks unavailable`). No session token, member id, address or query parameter reaches a line, the console included (`tests/auth-logging.test.ts`, `apps/api/test/auth-logging.test.ts`).

## Verified against installed versions

Pinned at verification: **better-auth 1.6.31**, **@better-auth/expo 1.6.31**, **jose 6.2.x**.

| #   | Assumption                                                                                                                | Result                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| --- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1   | `emailOTP({ sendVerificationOnSignUp, allowedAttempts, otpLength, expiresIn })`                                           | Accepted by 1.6.31 (API boots; options typed in plugin)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| 2   | `haveIBeenPwned({ customPasswordCompromisedMessage })` from `better-auth/plugins`                                         | Exported; used in production path                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| 3   | `jwt({ jwks: { keyPairConfig: { alg: "EdDSA", crv: "Ed25519" } }, disableSettingJwtHeader: true })`; `GET /api/auth/jwks` | Accepted; JWKS returns keys; member `GET /api/auth/get-session` has no `set-auth-jwt` (`library-assumptions.test.ts`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| 4   | `admin({ ac, roles, defaultRole, adminRoles })`                                                                           | Accepted                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| 5   | `rateLimit.customRules` keys `/sign-in/email` and `/email-otp/send-verification-otp`                                      | 6th sign-in → **429** + **`X-Retry-After`** (1.6.31 does not set standard `Retry-After`); 11th OTP send from one IP → **429** (10 sends / 15 min per IP); a second send to one address inside **30 s** mails nothing (`auth.otp_cooldown`); `resendStrategy: "reuse"` keeps the same digits when a second send is permitted (`library-assumptions.test.ts`, `otp-colleagues.test.ts`) |
| 6   | JWT `iss`/`aud` = `APP_ORIGIN`                                                                                            | Plugin defaults to `baseURL` origin; `jwtVerify` in `principal.ts` keeps both; decode + bearer probe green                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| 7   | `advanced.cookiePrefix: "bbc"` → `Set-Cookie: bbc.session_token`                                                          | Expo `expoClient({ cookiePrefix: "bbc" })` must match. Default `"better-auth"` ignores our cookies → empty `getCookie()` → `POST /v1/account/password` 401                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| 8   | `storeOTP: "encrypted"` + app `auth.otp_cooldown` (HMAC `otp_hash`) around send                                           | Verification value is not `\d{6}:…`; cooldown digest ≠ unkeyed sha256(otp); reuse + fail-retry + replacement still mail (`otp-colleagues.test.ts`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |

## Checklist A findings (schema / rate-limit — Better Auth 1.6.31)

1. **`generateId: "uuid"`** on 1.6.31 means _the database_ generates the id (`gen_random_uuid()`). Our CLI-generated `auth.user.id` is `text` with no default, so inserts failed with `null value in column "id"`. Fix: `database: { generateId: () => crypto.randomUUID() }` in `src/infrastructure/auth.ts` — app-side UUIDs, schema stays regen-safe.
2. **Rate-limit `customRules` route names** — live probe (6× `POST /api/auth/sign-in/email` with wrong password): `400 400 400 400 400 429`. **`/sign-in/email` matches Better Auth 1.6.31** (sixth response is 429).
3. **`auth.rate_limit.last_request`** — CLI schema used `integer`; Better Auth writes `Date.now()` ms which overflows in 2026. Column is `bigint` (migration `0004_auth_rate_limit_bigint.sql`).

## Checklist A — verified against better-auth 1.6.31

**Decision: path A** (OTP sign-in creates the account without a password; Set Password is a later club route).
Pinned by `apps/api/test/register-path.test.ts` and the in-process probe below (same Better Auth 1.6.31 handlers as `bun run --filter @bbc/api dev`).

| #   | Question                                | Command / check                                                               | Result                                                                |
| --- | --------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1   | Send OTP for unknown email              | `POST /api/auth/email-otp/send-verification-otp` `{ email, type: "sign-in" }` | **200**, OTP captured in capturing sender                             |
| 2   | Sign-in with OTP creates user + session | `POST /api/auth/sign-in/email-otp` `{ email, otp }`                           | **200**, `Set-Cookie` present; no credential password on the new user |
| 3   | `email_verified`                        | `SELECT email_verified FROM auth."user" WHERE email = …`                      | **true**                                                              |
| 4   | `member.registered` → profile           | drain poller; `SELECT count(*) FROM members.profile WHERE member_id = …`      | **1** (databaseHooks.user.create.after fired on OTP path)             |
| 5   | `name`                                  | `SELECT name FROM auth."user" …`                                              | **`""`** (empty string, no complaint)                                 |

Path B (`signUp.email` + throwaway password) is **not** required. Mobile Block 4 keeps join → OTP → `POST /v1/account/password`.
